from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c89012db.py')
p.write_text('''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg = max((v for v in counts if v != bg), key=counts.get)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row)-1):
            if row[c] == bg and row[c-1] == fg and row[c+1] == fg:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
''')
print(p.read_text())
